claims.explanation: E04, fig3_scalability.md and figb1_memory_growth.md give the O(n) argument in terms of a constant-size module m and fixed d_enc/d_model/action size, with symbolic entries such as approximately 10m rather than numeric parameter counts. The claim is universal linear asymptotic growth derived from six fixed transformations and a feed-forward block. Installed numeric reported relations do not prove that structural/asymptotic assertion; finite monotonic parameter comparisons would not establish it.

Table 1 supplies mean±std from ten seeds under E01/E02: 20-task Meta-World with SAC and 10-task SpaceInvaders/7-task Freeway with PPO, 1M steps per task. The conjunction covers every performance P(T) and FTr column with ge against all five baseline methods, excluding RT because it is a reference-transfer statistic rather than a sixth method. The parser retains six unsplit sequence-specific metric column labels, so six metric-specific best-baseline properties are necessary rather than silently conflating performance with forward transfer. No task or baseline is omitted, and equality remains allowed.

E03 and fig4_arch_validation.md discuss attention and internal-policy mechanisms for scenarios (i) and (iii), with approximate time-dependent qualitative matching patterns. Scenario (ii)'s general ability to learn a function over previous policies is not a numeric benchmark outcome in that evidence. Full three-scenario correctness—including learning from scratch without interference—cannot be replaced by the two approximate final returns or one dominant-attention comparison.

E04 and fig3_scalability.md contain separate main-figure measurements (d_enc=64, action size 6, up to 100 tasks) and Appendix C.1 readings (d_enc=39, action size 4, through 300 tasks), all approximate. C04 asserts slower empirical growth, O(n²) theoretical complexity, and an architectural parallel-attention explanation. Reported pairwise time ordering is not a growth-rate/curvature or complexity proof, and the catalog has no relation expressing that full assertion. The two configurations are not merged, nor is lower time at selected points substituted for slower scaling.

Table 1 supplies CompoNet FTr and RT for Meta-World, SpaceInvaders and Freeway; Figure D.2 explains RT as best-previous-task fine-tuning transfer. Those numbers permit FTr>RT comparisons, but the full Statement additionally asserts simultaneous use of compositional knowledge from multiple previous tasks. E01/E02 measure aggregate transfer, and E03's informative/non-informative predecessor scenarios do not establish that simultaneous multi-task mechanism. The stated FTr<=RT falsifier is a sufficient refutation condition, not an equivalence licensing removal of the mechanistic assertion. Following source-fidelity review, the prior directional-only declaration was removed rather than presented as discharging the full claim.
